capabilities.description: Controls temporary authority leases and whether higher-assurance deployments require signed leases.
capabilities.review_note: Review who may change effective policy during an incident and whether unsigned runtime authority is acceptable.
capabilities.title: Runtime policy authority

capabilities.description: Controls whether Repair runs, what authority it has, validation, retry, observation, rollback, and candidate restrictions.
capabilities.review_note: Review changes for repair autonomy, validation strength, replay safety, and activation boundaries.
capabilities.title: Repair lifecycle and authority

capabilities.description: Controls Guard collection, behavior comparison, target inspection, baselines, deviations, and actions.
capabilities.review_note: Review changes for new observation scope, enforcement behavior, and evidence requirements.
capabilities.title: Guard behavior analysis

capabilities.description: Controls application evidence capture, buffering, retention, attachments, signing, redaction, indexing, and failure behavior.
capabilities.review_note: Review changes for evidence loss, privacy exposure, retention, and tamper-evidence guarantees.
capabilities.title: Logging and retained evidence

capabilities.description: Controls host/process collection used to correlate Caretaker activity with operating-system state.
capabilities.review_note: Review changes for collection scope, privacy, storage volume, and failure behavior.
capabilities.title: System evidence collection

capabilities.description: Controls lightweight dependency/function observation, promotion, evidence-gated repair escalation, sampling, and demotion.
capabilities.review_note: Review changes for hot-path overhead, observation scope, repair eligibility, evidence sufficiency, and demotion behavior.
capabilities.title: Adaptive lightweight instrumentation

capabilities.description: Controls bounded behavior statistics, automatic materialization, restart reconstruction, and accepted-baseline snapshot handling.
capabilities.review_note: Review sampling/statistics cost, generation compatibility, automatic materialization, and baseline persistence semantics.
capabilities.title: Persistent behavior statistics and snapshots

capabilities.description: Controls opt-in randomized, bounded behavior epochs that preserve disjoint sample ranges and provenance.
capabilities.review_note: Review reproducibility, minimum useful epoch size, snapshot rate, and the fact that randomized snapshots remain evidence rather than an automatic baseline.
capabilities.title: Randomized behavior snapshot boundaries

capabilities.description: Controls bounded, type-only categories and non-value structural buckets observed from successful Behavior-stage returns.
capabilities.review_note: Review category/shape cardinality, type-name disclosure, generation provenance, safe container handling, and overflow handling.
capabilities.title: Bounded return behavior categories and shapes

capabilities.description: Controls bounded durable operator-directed behavior capture requests and opt-in automatic backlog promotion.
capabilities.review_note: Review queue backpressure, priority/deadline handling, restart recovery, cancellation, automatic-promotion limits, and evidence-only provenance.
capabilities.title: Policy-governed operator behavior collection scheduling

capabilities.description: Controls the minimum isolation capability required before a repair candidate may pass validation and the fail-closed action when that backend is unavailable.
capabilities.review_note: Review whether automatic repair can run with PROCESS, CONTAINER, VM, or EXTERNAL isolation and how unavailable stronger isolation is handled.
capabilities.title: Validation isolation requirements

capabilities.description: Controls the independent signing-identity journal used to retain public identities and ephemeral key transitions required to verify signed runtime artifacts.
capabilities.review_note: Review identity retention against the longest retained signed artifact and the configured runtime signing assurance mode.
capabilities.title: Runtime signing identity retention

capabilities.description: Controls whether an operator may record an applied adaptive transition as a durable deployment handoff.
capabilities.review_note: Review that acceptance remains opt-in, context-bound, signed when available, and unable to mutate authority or reactivate policy.
capabilities.title: Persistent adaptive-policy acceptance

capabilities.description: Allows a local LLM to suggest clearer wording for an already redacted incident communication draft.
capabilities.review_note: Review that tailoring is opt-in, bounded, advisory-only, preserves the canonical draft, and cannot authorize delivery or change incident state.
capabilities.title: Advisory incident communication language tailoring

capabilities.description: Controls the lifecycle and authority boundaries for field repairs and their later deployment promotion.
capabilities.review_note: Review validation gates, staged rollout permissions, expiry, revocation, and the requirement for deployment authority before permanence.
capabilities.title: Policy-bound Repair rollout authority

capabilities.description: Controls bounded detection of newly observed return categories and structural shapes against an accepted Guard baseline.
capabilities.review_note: Review generation, successful-sample, and repeated-observation requirements; novelty remains evidence and cannot by itself authorize Repair or treat an incomplete return table as proof of absence.
capabilities.title: Policy-gated live return novelty detection

capabilities.description: Controls the optional bounded metric stream and its external-monitoring serialization dialects.
capabilities.review_note: Review metric disclosure, record bounds, local file permissions, dialect compatibility, and the fact that the stream cannot act as a command or authority channel.
capabilities.title: Output-only monitoring stream

capabilities.description: Controls optional byte/time bounds that rotate the local audit stream while preserving verifiable segment and hash-chain continuity.
capabilities.review_note: Review segment bounds, manifest permissions, crash recovery behavior, and the fact that rotation does not delete retained evidence or provide external anchoring.
capabilities.title: Manifest-backed audit segment rotation

capabilities.description: Controls bounded archive-before-delete compaction of ordinary, unreferenced Repair records without requiring a live operator when explicitly enabled.
capabilities.review_note: Review automatic-compaction authority, archive verification, reference-scan bounds, protected evidence, idempotency, and critical audit requirements.
capabilities.title: Policy-authorized Repair retention compaction
